text:
rachel: Dumping notes from today's quick design convo — trying an alternative approach to warmup control: lease-based warmup windows + decay credits. Wanted feedback on tradeoffs.

rachel: Problem: warmup storms happen when many coalesced batches independently request prefetch; we overcommit memory and then OOM or cause noisy eviction.

ben: What's a lease-based warmup window?

rachel: Idea: before emitting warmup hints, a coalescer must acquire a short-lived warmup lease for a node (e.g., 200ms). Lease grants a small warmup_commit budget. Leases are cheap to check and expire automatically.

kaito: So leases are per-node, not per-tenant? Or both?

rachel: Both. Two-layer leases: node-lease to limit global warmup concurrency and tenant-lease to limit per-tenant ramp. Tenant-lease requests can be denied if node budget low.

irma: How do decay credits fit?

rachel: Decay credits are a soft currency that refill slowly over time. Emitting a hint spends credits proportional to estimated_bytes. Credits decay additively back at a tuned rate. This prevents bursty re-emission.

ben: Sounds complex. Any simple proto?

rachel: Minimal: AcquireLease(node_id, tenant_id, requested_bytes) -> {granted_bytes, ttl_ms}. EmitWarmupHint(batch_id, bytes). Lease auto-expires; refunds are not required (best-effort). Credits tracked locally in coalescer for quick checks.

kaito: Failure modes? If many leases granted then actual fetch spikes. Need a hard cap at fetch executor and a safety valve to drop hints.

irma: Can we make leases conservative by default? E.g., only grant 25% of requested and set ttl short. Also use sampling: only a fraction of hints actually trigger prefetch.

ben: Telemetry list: lease_grants, lease_denials, warmup_hint_emit_rate, warmup_fetch_bytes, decay_credit_level, hint_sample_accept_rate, split_count.

rachel: Rollout: implement lease & decay in coalescer shim behind ff. Start with sampling=0.1 and tiny budgets on a staging pool.

kaito: How does this interact with deadline-aware coalescing? If deadline is short we should bypass warmup entirely.

rachel: Agreed. Policy: deadline < short_deadline_ms => never request lease. Coalescer should tag batch as NO_WARMUP.

irma: Client signals/backpressure? If leases denied frequently we should tell frontends to switch to immediate-ack or reduce prefetch depth. Small proto: {level, suggested_prefetch, ttl_ms}.

ben: Add rollback rule: if node_warmup_fetch_bytes > 60% capacity for 3m OR p95 latency regresses > 12% => auto-disable leases for pool.

rachel: I'll code the shim + unit tests. Kaito can help with node-side safety cap. Ben will add Prom rules and dashboards. Irma will draft rollout steps and alerts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pushed warmup-lease-shim branch to staging-pool-omega at 6199991350.

rachel: Thanks, will monitor metrics and post PR link.

kaito: Quick implementation note: make lease check lock-free and bounded. We should avoid blocking hotpath.

irma: Meeting follow-up: 20m sync tomorrow to review metrics after a short soak.

ben: I'll add histograms and an SLO guard chart.

rachel: :thumbsup:
